INSERT INTO CONNECTIONS ( USER_ID, INSTITUTION_ID, LOGIN_TYPE, LOGIN_ID, LOGIN_PASSWORD, STATUS, CONNECTED_AT ) VALUES
( #{userId}, #{connection.institutionId}, #{loginType}, #{loginId}, #{loginPassword},
'ACTIVE' 'FAILED' , NOW() )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE login_type = VALUES(login_type), login_id = VALUES(login_id), login_password = VALUES(login_password), status = VALUES(status), last_sync_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, connected_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted_at = NULL

SELECT c.connection_id AS connectionId, a.account_id AS assetId, c.institution_id AS institutionId, i.name AS institutionName, i.type AS institutionType, i.logo_url AS logoUrl, i.financial_group_code AS financialGroupCode, i.financial_group_name AS financialGroupName, c.last_sync_at AS lastSyncAt, 'ACCOUNT' AS assetKind, a.account_name AS assetName, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.account_display_number, ''), a.account_number) AS displayNumber, a.account_type AS assetType, CASE WHEN a.account_type = 'STOCK' THEN COALESCE(a.eval_amount, 0) WHEN a.account_type = 'LOAN' THEN -COALESCE(a.balance, 0) ELSE COALESCE(a.balance, 0) END AS amount, a.currency AS currency FROM CONNECTIONS c INNER JOIN INSTITUTIONS i ON i.institution_id = c.institution_id INNER JOIN ACCOUNTS a ON a.connection_id = c.connection_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
UNION ALL
SELECT c.connection_id AS connectionId, card.card_id AS assetId, c.institution_id AS institutionId, i.name AS institutionName, i.type AS institutionType, i.logo_url AS logoUrl, i.financial_group_code AS financialGroupCode, i.financial_group_name AS financialGroupName, c.last_sync_at AS lastSyncAt, 'CARD' AS assetKind, card.card_name AS assetName, CASE WHEN LENGTH(REPLACE(card.card_number, '-', '')) >= 8 THEN CONCAT( LEFT(REPLACE(card.card_number, '-', ''), 4), '-****-****-', RIGHT(REPLACE(card.card_number, '-', ''), 4) ) ELSE card.card_number END AS displayNumber, card.card_type AS assetType, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS amount, 'KRW' AS currency FROM CONNECTIONS c INNER JOIN INSTITUTIONS i ON i.institution_id = c.institution_id INNER JOIN CARDS card ON card.connection_id = c.connection_id LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS t ON t.card_id = card.card_id AND t.type = 'EXPENSE' AND t.transaction_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01') AND t.transaction_date <= CURRENT_DATE WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND card.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.connection_id, card.card_id, c.institution_id, i.name, i.type, i.logo_url, i.financial_group_code, i.financial_group_name, c.last_sync_at, card.card_name, card.card_number, card.card_type
ORDER BY institutionName, assetKind, assetId
